classification.B: paper-trading-blocking (correctness in the active trading path)

items.description: Session gate compares naive/UTC clock times directly against Asia/Kolkata (IST) market hours. PaperTradingLoop.process_signal gates on this check, so real NSE-hours paper trading would be classified CLOSED during much of the trading day. calendar.timezone_name is never applied.
items.resolution: Evaluate all session logic in the calendar timezone (zoneinfo Asia/Kolkata, UTC+5:30 fallback).

items.description: No deployment guard for live broker modes: ZerodhaBroker / AngelOneBroker / AlpacaBroker are instantiable and can place real orders whenever credentials are configured. Additionally, the `except ImportError: return OrderStatus.FILLED` fallback wrongly reports success if httpx is missing, and the fallback for mode="live" silently routes to SimulatedBroker instead of failing. Live trading must remain CLOSED and fail-closed.
items.resolution: Add QUANTLAB_LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED gate (default off) enforced in create_broker and ExecutionEngine for live-able modes; fail closed.

items.description: Raises NotImplementedError('Use the market data pipeline'). Abstract method exists for interface completeness; market data flows through the data pipeline instead. Acceptable for research/paper; document.
items.resolution: Documented as interface stub; historical data comes from the market data pipeline.

items.location: IntegratedBot.run_cycle default signal (close parity coin-flip: LONG if close%2==0 else SHORT)
items.description: Default integration signal is an explicitly simulated/demo signal (also used inside run_simulation). It is a research sandbox toggle, not an approved strategy. COMP3 gate is closed so no real promotion occurs via this path.
items.resolution: Documented: IntegratedBot is the autonomous RESEARCH module; its default signal is a simulation fixture, kept for reproducibility, and must never be treated as an approved strategy.

items.description: On cash shortfall the engine silently reduces order.quantity to the max affordable and proceeds. Safe (cash never goes negative) but mutates an order that already passed risk. Paper-path modeling choice.
items.resolution: Keep the clamp as a fail-safe but log a warning and report adjusted quantity; document as an accounting fail-safe.

items.description: RiskConfig fields are expressed as percentages (e.g. max_position_size_pct: 20.0) while RiskBudget stores fractions (0.10). No code currently wires ProductionConfig.risk into RiskEngine, so the mismatch is latent, but it is a footgun for any future wiring.
items.resolution: Document the unit divergence; recommend explicit fraction values at wiring time (no automatic wiring added).
